text: the curve you see is my own skin on the cover that hangs on the side of the wall
resolution: Clarification from the user, not a new defect: the white CURVED shape I flagged as possibly-stale in req_2051 is actually the user's own COVER piece (an awning that hangs on the side of the wall) wearing their skin — a legitimate, correctly-rendered piece, not leftover geometry. This resolves my open question on req_2051: there is NO separate live-skin bug to chase. Verified my req_2051 erase-lift change cannot affect the cover: liftedWallBaseY only lifts WALL_REST_KINDS (wall/fence/railing/pillar/corner/arch, placed.ts:261), so pieceEraseRect is a pure no-op for props/covers — only true wall-family pieces get the lifted erase rect. So the actual stale piece the user hit was a floor-resting WALL, which the req_2051 fix (c5a165498) addresses, and the cover is untouched. No code change for this entry. Pending the user's live retest on a rebuilt dev host to confirm the deleted wall now clears.
